avoid_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive 5-alpha reductase inhibition may cause excessive DHT suppression and unpredictable therapeutic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue saw palmetto before finasteride initiation

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer may significantly reduce finasteride plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor PSA and symptom response closely

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may marginally reduce finasteride levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor therapeutic response; no dose adjustment typically needed but inform patient of potential interaction

caution_supplements.name: Licorice
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have weak hormonal effects; potential additive effects on DHT modulation
caution_supplements.action: Counsel to limit licorice intake; monitor for any changes in efficacy or adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase finasteride absorption and plasma concentrations slightly
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain stable dietary pattern for consistent drug levels

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly elevate finasteride concentrations
caution_foods.action: Avoid excessive grapefruit juice consumption; occasional intake likely minimal impact

monitoring_notes: Monitor PSA levels and BPH/hair loss symptoms regularly during therapy, especially if concurrent CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors are initiated. Counsel patients on consistent dosing timing and to report any decreased efficacy or unexpected adverse effects.
